whyMatters.en: Seattle four-piece that put twin-harmony vocals over down-tuned hard-rock riffs; Facelift (1990) and Dirt (1992) sit on the metal side of grunge radio.
whyMatters.zh: 西雅图四人组：双人声和谐叠在降调 hard-rock riff 上；Facelift（1990）与 Dirt（1992）站在 grunge 电台里更偏 metal 的一侧。

shortBio.en: Staley / Cantrell harmony grunge-metal; Dirt is the down-tuned radio peak.
shortBio.zh: Staley / Cantrell 和声 grunge-metal；Dirt 是降调电台高峰。

body.en:
Formed 1987 in Seattle. Facelift brought talk-box riffs and close vocal thirds to US rock radio; Dirt (1992) fixed the sludgy template—Cantrell's drop-D riffs, Staley's tenor, addiction-era lyrics.

Man in the Box (1990) remains the entry. They share the Seattle map with Soundgarden and Pearl Jam but keep a clearer metal lineage via Cantrell's riff writing.
body.zh:
1987 年于西雅图组建。Facelift 把 talk-box riff 与贴近三度和声送上美国摇滚电台；Dirt（1992）定型 sludge 模板——Cantrell drop-D riff、Staley 男高音、成瘾题材歌词。

Man in the Box（1990）仍是入口。与 Soundgarden、Pearl Jam 同属西雅图地图，但 Cantrell riff 写作更贴近 metal 谱系。

title.zh: Metal 侧 grunge 上的和声人声

body.en:
Facelift (1990) puts Alice in Chains on MTV beside Nirvana and Pearl Jam. Cantrell and Staley's stacked thirds differ from Cobain's lone melody; talk-box and drop-D riffs mark the metal edge.

Dirt (1992) consolidates: Rooster, Them Bones, Would?—slow grind and odd meters on the same album cycle.
body.zh:
Facelift（1990）把 Alice in Chains 送上 MTV，与 Nirvana、Pearl Jam 并列。Cantrell 与 Staley 叠三度不同于 Cobain 单线旋律；talk-box 与 drop-D riff 标记 metal 边缘。

Dirt（1992） Consolidate：Rooster、Them Bones、Would?——慢 grind 与奇数拍同处一专辑周期。

title.zh: Staley 时期 vs DuVall 回归

body.en:
Peak four: Staley, Cantrell, Kinney, Starr on Facelift; Mike Inez replaces Starr for Dirt and Jar of Flies. Staley's last recordings taper mid-1990s; William DuVall joins for 2006 reunion shows.

Catalog citation peak is Staley/Cantrell harmony on Dirt—DuVall chapter extends touring, not the first citation.
body.zh:
巅峰四人：Staley、Cantrell、Kinney、Starr 录 Facelift；Mike Inez 替 Starr 录 Dirt 与 Jar of Flies。Staley 最后录音收束于 1990 年代中；William DuVall 2006 重聚演出加入。

目录引用峰值是 Dirt 上 Staley/Cantrell 和声——DuVall 章节延长巡演，非首引层。

title.en: Twin-vocal sludge in 1990s metal and alt
title.zh: 1990 年代 metal 与 alt 里的双声和 sludge

body.en:
Black Sabbath and Led Zeppelin sit in Cantrell's riff DNA; Van Halen harmonics echo in Facelift leads. Tool and Deftones inherit the down-tuned weight and dynamic patience.

Influence is the harmony-over-sludge model—later bands copy the vocal stack more than the Seattle flannel costume.
body.zh:
Black Sabbath 与 Led Zeppelin 在 Cantrell riff DNA 里；Van Halen 泛音在 Facelift 主音中有回响。Tool 与 Deftones 继承降调重量与动态耐心。

影响是和声叠 sludge 模型——后期乐队多抄人声堆叠，少抄西雅图法兰绒戏服。
